initialize_result.instructions: When the user asks about a Qt API (signals, slots, properties, default values, since-version), use qt_documentation_search to verify before answering. Framework docs cover Qt 6.12, 6.11, 6.8 LTS and Qt 5.15; pass version to target one (the default is the latest). Product docs include Qt Creator, Qt Design Studio, Qt for MCUs, Boot to Qt, Squish and Coco. Your training may be wrong on Qt 6 APIs, lesser-known modules (Qt MQTT, Qt OPC UA, QtGrpc), and the precise distinction between public functions and public slots — these are the patterns where training is unreliable.

serverInfo.description: Qt 5 and Qt 6 framework and product docs: Qt Creator, MCUs, Squish, Coco and more.
serverInfo.name: qt-docs-server

tools.description: Call qt_documentation_search when: (a) you're about to claim a signal/slot/property/default exists, (b) the API is in Qt 6.7+ or a non-core module (MQTT, OPC UA, Network Auth, etc), (c) the user used the words 'docs', 'official', 'verify', or 'check'. Skip when: the question is about basic QString/QObject/signal-slot syntax.

filter.description: Optional: Filter by document type. One of 'all', 'class', 'qml', 'function', 'guide'. Default is 'all'. Note: 'function' returns the class reference page that contains the function; pass the function name as 'symbol' to the read tool to get just that member. For QML, use 'qml'.

intent.description: Optional: Prioritizes (not filters) results by type. One of 'api', 'tutorial', 'guide', 'concept', 'example', 'migration'. 'api'=class reference, 'tutorial'=how-to guides, 'guide'=overviews, 'concept'=explanations, 'example'=code samples, 'migration'=porting guides.

keywords.description: Optional: Array of keywords to search for. Results match ANY keyword. Example: ["button", "signal", "connect"]. Alternative to 'query' for better multi-term matching.

max_results.description: Optional: Maximum number of results to return (1-10). Default is 3.

module.description: Optional: Limit search to specific Qt module (e.g., 'qtcore', 'qtwidgets', 'qtqml', 'qtquick', 'qtnetwork')

product.description: Optional: Limit search to a specific documentation product (e.g. 'qt', 'qtcreator', 'pyside6'). Omit to search all products.

query.description: Search query for Qt documentation (e.g., 'Animation', 'QTimer', 'signal slot'). Optional if 'keywords' is provided.

version.description: Optional: Qt version to search (e.g., '6.10.0', '6.9.0'). Defaults to latest installed version if not specified.

tools.name: qt_documentation_search

tools.description: Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page, or a single member of it with 'symbol'. Use the filename shown in search results.

file.description: Documentation page filename from a search result (e.g. 'signalsandslots.html'), or a module-relative path (e.g. 'qtcore/qobject.html').

symbol.description: Optional: Return only one member's documentation instead of the whole page. A name (e.g. 'singleShot', 'anchors.fill', 'AlignmentFlag', 'onCompleted') returns every overload and any property of that name; an enum constant or property access function returns its enum or property. An anchor, shown as {#anchor} after each signature (e.g. 'singleShot-5'), returns that block only. An unknown name returns the page's member list.

version.description: Optional: Qt version to read from (e.g., '6.10.0'). Defaults to the latest installed version.

tools.name: qt_documentation_read
